title: Onion Rings
description: Draw two thin concentric white rings on a black background. Layer the shape in two passes. The first pass turns a circle of radius 0.6 into a band that reaches 0.15 to each side. The second pass turns that band into two outlines, each reaching 0.04 to each side. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: abs(d) - r wraps a shape's edge into an outline of half-width r. Do it once to get a ring, then do it again on the result to get two rings.
